mutants.name: m01_fund_before_margin.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is used before its initial margin (layer order swapped).

mutants.name: m02_capital_before_fund.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is used before the defaulter's default fund (layer order swapped).

mutants.name: m03_survivors_by_count.py
mutants.description: surviving members pay equal shares by count, not pro rata to their default funds.

mutants.name: m04_leftover_to_last_survivor.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the last surviving member instead of the first.

mutants.name: m05_no_remainder_rule.py
mutants.description: survivor shares are truncated and the leftover cents are never paid, so the invariant breaks.

mutants.name: m06_uncovered_dropped.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss above the survivors' total is dropped instead of reported.

mutants.name: m07_floor_index.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is the floor of target times count over 10000, not its ceiling.

mutants.name: m08_strict_cover.py
mutants.description: the cover counts only losses strictly below the margin, so a loss equal to the margin is not covered.

mutants.name: m09_largest_loss_always.py
mutants.description: the margin for every target is the largest loss, with no quantile at all.

mutants.name: m10_seed0_hardcoded.py
mutants.description: the sizing returns the seed-0 margin for 9500 bps (73529 cents) for every instance and target.

mutants.name: n1_defaulter_checked_in_margins_only.py
mutants.description: the defaulter is checked against the margin dictionary only, so a defaulter present in the margins but absent from the default funds is accepted (the member ids are the keys of default_fund_cents).

mutants.name: n2_cover_skips_negative_loss_check.py
mutants.description: cover_bps does not refuse a negative loss; only margin_for_cover checks the sign of the losses.

mutants.name: n3_remainder_to_highest_id_first.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the surviving members in descending id order, so the highest id is paid first.

mutants.name: n4_margin_layer_pools_all_margins.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's margin layer uses the sum of every member's initial margin instead of the defaulter's own.

mutants.name: r12a_survivor_share_rounded_up.py
mutants.description: each survivor's pro rata share is rounded up to a whole cent (a ceiling), not floored, so the shares can exceed the residual.

mutants.name: r12b_sizing_index_float.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is computed in floats as target / 10000 * count and rounded up, not in integers as the page requires.

mutants.name: r12c_only_one_leftover_cent.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents are paid one cent only, to the first survivor with a positive fund, so a residual with two or more leftover cents leaves cents unpaid.

mutants.name: r12d_uncovered_added_to_first_survivor.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss is added to the first survivor's payment, so the survivors pay more than their whole default funds.

mutants.name: r13a_leftover_only_to_positive_share.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go only to survivors whose computed share is already positive, so a residual smaller than the survivor count leaves cents unpaid.

mutants.name: r13b_uncovered_negative_below_pool.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss is set to the residual less the survivors' pool in both branches, so it is negative when the residual is below the pool.

mutants.name: r13c_cover_skips_the_last_scenario.py
mutants.description: the cover loop stops one scenario early (it reads the losses without the last one) but still divides by the full count of scenarios.

mutants.name: r13d_fund_layer_capped_at_survivor_pool.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the surviving members' pool, so the fund layer can pay less than the defaulter's whole contribution when the pool is smaller.

mutants.name: r14a_defaulter_id_range_fixed_at_four_members.py
mutants.description: the defaulter id is checked against a fixed range of 1 to 4, as if there were four members, so a valid defaulter in a five- or six-member set is refused.

mutants.name: r14b_survivors_in_dictionary_order.py
mutants.description: the survivors are taken in the order the default-fund dictionary lists them, not in ascending id order, so the leftover cent goes to whichever surviving member the dictionary lists first.

mutants.name: r14c_negative_fund_check_skips_survivors.py
mutants.description: a negative default fund for a surviving member is accepted, because the non-negative check is applied to the defaulter's fund only, so a negative share can follow.

mutants.name: r14d_warns_on_uncovered_loss.py
mutants.description: a warning is issued when a loss is uncovered, which is a valid output, so the module warns on a valid input and the suite run with warnings as errors fails.

mutants.name: r15a_margin_strict_count_position.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover counts the losses strictly below each loss, so it returns the loss one place above the k-th smallest at every target.

mutants.name: r15b_default_fund_capped_at_full_loss.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the full loss, not at what the margin left of the loss, so the fund and the margin can pay the same cent twice.

mutants.name: r15d_leftover_by_largest_remainder.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the survivors with the largest fractional remainders (the largest-remainder method), not to the first survivors in ascending id order.

mutants.name: r15e_cover_divides_by_count_minus_one.py
mutants.description: cover_bps divides by one fewer than the number of scenarios (a sample-size slip), so every cover is overstated.

mutants.name: r16a_target_message_omits_target_bps.py
mutants.description: the target refusal says the target is out of range but does not name target_bps, so the learner cannot see which input failed.

mutants.name: r16b_defaulter_margin_read_at_zero_based_index.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's initial margin is read at key defaulter_id - 1, a zero-based position applied to the one-based member ids.

mutants.name: r16c_default_fund_ignores_the_margin_already_paid.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the full loss instead of at the loss the margin left, so the fund can pay what the margin already paid.

mutants.name: r16d_loss_refusal_message_omits_loss_cents.py
mutants.description: the negative-loss refusal in waterfall words the message without naming loss_cents, so the learner cannot tell which input was negative.

mutants.name: r16e_cover_sorts_the_callers_list_in_place.py
mutants.description: cover_bps sorts the caller's scenario list in place before counting, so the list the caller passed is reordered.

mutants.name: r17a_capital_layer_ignores_margin_paid.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is sized on the loss less the default fund only, so the margin's cents are paid again by the capital.

mutants.name: r17b_sizing_drops_the_last_loss.py
mutants.description: the sizing reads the k-th smallest of the losses without the last scenario, so the largest scenario is never counted.

mutants.name: r17c_margin_layer_reads_the_fund_table.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's margin layer reads the default-fund table, a dictionary mix-up, so the margin is taken from the fund.

mutants.name: r17d_zero_margin_covers_nothing.py
mutants.description: a margin of zero is read as no margin, so cover_bps returns zero even when zero losses are at the margin.

mutants.name: r17e_uncovered_subtracts_the_capital_again.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss subtracts the CCP capital a second time, so an uncovered loss is understated.

mutants.name: r18a_full_cover_margin_is_last_loss_given.py
mutants.description: the margin for a 10000 bps target is the last loss in the list the caller passed, not the largest loss.

mutants.name: r18b_capital_paid_after_survivors.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is used after the surviving members pay, so the survivors pay the residual before the capital covers it.

mutants.name: r18c_uncovered_reports_the_residual.py
mutants.description: when the residual is at or above the survivors' total, the uncovered loss is reported as the whole residual, not the excess above the total.

mutants.name: r18d_waterfall_result_not_frozen.py

mutants.name: r19a_leftover_to_every_positive_survivor.py
